brief: Act for fictional shelter coordinator Etta. Complete current per-animal placements,distinct kit-title custody and post-transfer keeper records. All animals,people,clinical-looking sealed packet codes and services are invented;no treatment or dosage advice.

delegation.title: Etta’s current eight commissions
delegation.body: Preserve both feasible current placements under each animal’s exact placement owner. Act on the authenticated before0 Maple-only notice,not the old Sami list. Check full chips,replace the return-only Maple travel packet with its permanently transferable sealed kit,return clinic-owned packet and empty loan crate separately,and preserve Mallow’s unchanged partner-owned kit/placement. Complete actual separate foster receiving before own keeper updates;keeper is not legal owner. Repair actual shelter/carrier held lists,give each current foster its own usable full handover,tell former Sami its own cancellation,and send clinic/registry/carrier their own operating results. Correct the public all-keeper/kit-transfer claim and finish privately with actual receipts. House crate replacement is lawful and does not erase the clinic packet-return duty.

calendar.body: Minute0 is09:00. Clinic Gate2 packet/empty-crate receiving closes80. Yen’s staffed final foster receiving closes90;Sol’s100. Actual identity/current and permanent kits/current verified before either foster placement;Maple also needs actual crate/current verification. Clinic return is its own actual service,not proved by animal delivery or registry edit. Registry own update requires corresponding actual final foster verified first. Owner125 inclusive. Every window is an invented actual desk staffing cutoff;early completion and no optional request allowed.

source/intake.title: Two distinct animal identities
source/intake.body: Intake D41 is Maple,full chip98500641,green collar,intake tag41. Intake D14 is Mallow,full chip98500614,green collar,intake tag14. Collar colour and shared boarding address12 Birch Lane do not identify either animal. rights/placement.title: Before0 official notice and separate placement owners
rights/placement.body: Authenticated Cedar notice signed08:30 before0:Maple D41/98500641 Sami F41 placement ended;current accepted foster is Sol F41-S. This applies only to Maple. Cedar remains Maple placement owner. Mallow D14/98500614 belongs to partner Lake shelter,whose signed standing instruction appoints Yen F14 and authorizes Etta’s exact check/kit/transport/keeper handoff;no transfer of Lake legal title. Birch Clinic is administrative registered keeper for boarding only. Ria temporary care/transport for Maple never supplied placement or kit title. No new reply is needed for current Sol or unchanged Yen;old Sami token cannot collect after before0 notice.

source/kits.title: Raw sealed packet and container title ledger
source/kits.body: Maple D41/full chip98500641 currently has temporary sealed travel packet K-G41,clinic-owned and return-only at clinic Gate2 by80;matching chip/green mark does not permit leaving it at foster. Cedar-owned permanent sealed K-P41 is approved to accompany Maple to current Sol. Both unopened,no medicine name,dose or recommendation. Mallow D14/98500614 has partner Lake-owned sealed K-B14,which must remain with Mallow to unchanged Yen,not clinic return. Clinic loan crate C41 currently contains Maple and must return empty. House H0 is a suitable authorized Maple replacement;partner crate C14 remains with Mallow. Choosing H0 never transfers K-G41 title or removes its return.

source/registry.title: Keeper after own receiving,legal owner unchanged
source/registry.body: After actual Maple receiving at Sol,change full chip98500641 keeper Birch→Sol while retaining Cedar placement owner. After actual Mallow receiving at Yen,change full chip98500614 keeper Birch→Yen while retaining partner Lake placement owner. A keeper field never changes legal owner. Registry gets own chip/old-new keeper/actual transfer basis/unchanged placement owner only,not kits or clinic loan details. A registry message is not a completed physical handoff.

service/copies.title: Usable receiving papers and independent instructions
service/copies.body: shelter/placements and carrier/routes are independently held current instructions requiring actual repair by70. Foster own pack:own intake/full chip,own permanent sealed kit,current actual approved foster/placement owner,own crate and practical Gate4 blue-sign level shelter path/token,own receiving status only. Clinic pack includes its own K-G41 and empty C41 return at Gate2,not Mallow or private Sol details. Carrier full route gives distinct animal/kit/container destinations and chosen origin-versus-clinic relay. Sami gets only its own ended F41 Maple collection notice. No new file or SEND automatically repairs old held list.

profile.title: Etta’s invented correspondence
profile.body: Past public: “The green collars are alike; the animals’ chip records are separate.” “The shelter chooses placements. The chip register records the keeper.” Past foster note: “Your sealed kit travels with your animal. Please keep the packet closed and use the contact printed inside your own shelter papers.” Etta uses reassuring concrete custody facts and never speculates about treatment.

contacts.title: Private channels and delivery semantics
contacts.body: The coordinator owns all this task and may receive all private task facts. FINISH is a private handoff to private:coordinator and does not send any independent operational message. SEND accepts canonical recipients or their unique protocol aliases and stores an independent private snapshot. External parties receive only their own role-relevant subset. A completed current-version VERIFY establishes actual receiving at a named service. New files and messages do not automatically change old independently held objects. Provenance inputs are audit links, never extra printed pages.

source/route.title: Two lawful actual crate/custody routes
source/route.body: House route:bring H0 to Ria origin,perform actual checked Maple move from C41 into H0 before final transport;return now-empty C41 and sealed K-G41 separately to clinic Gate2. Clinic relay route:carry checked Maple in C41 to clinic Gate2 relay,actually move Maple into H0 there,then receive empty C41 and K-G41 as clinic return;Maple proceeds in H0 with permanent K-P41 to Sol. Both routes preserve identity and owner-specific paperwork. Mallow goes in its own C14 with K-B14 directly to Yen;Maple’s notice and clinic return have no Mallow scope. Carrier receives actual selected origin/relay/desks,not clinical advice or private registry ownership assumptions.

Old Sami F41 takes Maple with green K-G41;Birch keeper owns both animals,put both under Cedar.
Leave clinic C41 and K-G41 with Maple/Sami;return Mallow C14/K-B14 to clinic with other blue packets.
